query.name: project-change-count
query.comment: Number of configuration changes per project
query.sql: SELECT audit.entity_id, MAX(audit.id), COUNT(audit.id), 0 FROM awa_audit AS audit INNER JOIN awa_audit_field AS field ON audit.field = field.id WHERE audit.id >= :last_audit AND audit.entity_type = $entity_type[porion_project] AND (field.name = 'name' OR field.name = 'scm_url' OR field.name = 'scm' OR field.name = 'check_delay') GROUP BY audit.entity_id ORDER BY audit.entity_id

query.name: recipe-change-count
query.comment: Number of recipe changes per project
query.sql: SELECT recipe.project_id, MAX(audit.id), COUNT(audit.id), 0 FROM awa_audit AS audit INNER JOIN porion_recipe AS recipe ON recipe.id = audit.entity_id INNER JOIN awa_audit_field AS field ON audit.field = field.id WHERE audit.id >= :last_audit AND audit.entity_type = $entity_type[porion_recipe] AND (field.name = 'name' OR field.name = 'description' OR field.name = 'rate_factor' OR field.name = 'filter_rules') GROUP BY recipe.project_id ORDER BY recipe.project_id

query.name: build-count
query.comment: Number of builds and source change per project
query.sql: SELECT build.project_id, MAX(audit.id), COUNT(audit.id), SUM(build.source_changes) FROM awa_audit AS audit INNER JOIN porion_build AS build ON build.id = audit.entity_id INNER JOIN awa_audit_field AS field ON audit.field = field.id WHERE audit.id >= :last_audit AND audit.entity_type = $entity_type[porion_build] AND (field.name = 'id') GROUP BY build.project_id ORDER BY build.project_id

query.name: first-audit-after-date
query.comment: Get the audit id of the first change that occured after a given date
query.sql: SELECT MIN(audit.id) FROM awa_audit AS audit WHERE audit.date > :date

query.name: audit-day-activity
query.comment: Get the audit stat changes per day
query.sql: SELECT COUNT(audit.id), strftime("%Y-%m-%d", audit.date) AS day FROM awa_audit AS audit WHERE audit.id >= 1 GROUP BY day
